ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels localized at distal margins and 60% low-intensity black pixels localized at the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the outer lateral regions of both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation covers the fluke center, peduncle junction, and lower interior margins with irregular mottling transition zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire trailing edge of both lobes, characterized by varying pixel amplitudes (3-12 pixels) and sharp peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, showing a slight upward sweep at the extreme lateral margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white circular/irregular pixel masses (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, dark, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the white-pigmented surface of the right lobe (viewer perspective).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle encrustations present on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; vertical scarring visible on the right lobe pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive occlusion by high-intensity pixel clusters (water droplets/spray) across the central horizontal axis of the fluke surface.
